title: Let it Burn.
reviewNotes: All 58 source states and captions reviewed; native image 46 establishes the complete seven-piece final fork at 78s: White Ka6/Nd7/b3 versus Black Kc8/Qf8/a5/e7, White to move. Four selected branches check 10 distinct positions and 10 encoded moves: source Nxf8, an explicitly independent central pawn race, and two independent losing missed-fork choices. Earlier eleven-piece sacrifices remain outside exact verification. The winning knight ending is not described as immediate mate or a complete forced conversion.
